component.name: AnkiTov
component.summary: Classroom spaced-repetition practice on your own server

description.p: AnkiTov is a local spaced-repetition server for classrooms and self-study: a dashboard, an API, and a browser reviewer over an Anki-compatible (FSRS) schedule. It runs on your machine with a single SQLite file — no analytics, no third-party services, no accounts on someone else's infrastructure.
Start it, open http://localhost:5150, claim the teacher account on first run, and import the bundled CC0 deck packs.
